title: Veterans Pension Declaration of One-Time VA Payments
content:
# Declaring one-time VA payments — Veterans Pension

A retroactive compensation release deposited to a Veterans Pension recipient after his compensation award has ended is a one-time VA payment, nonrecurring income that the veteran declares in his own words as an income change report, dated on the date of the most recent compensation release he declares.

**What is not declared.** VA refunds of the veteran's own money, such as a home loan funding fee refund or the refund of a debt overcollection, are not income and are not declared.

| Payment deposited to the veteran | Declared |
|---|---|
| Retroactive compensation release deposited after the compensation award has ended | yes — one-time income |
| Home loan funding fee refund | no — a refund of his own money |
| Refund of a debt overcollection | no — a refund of his own money |

**Date of the declaration.** The date of the most recent compensation release the veteran declares.

**Ages and periods measured to the filing day.** Every age and period the declaration measures is measured to the day the veteran files it, not to the date it carries.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a declaration filed on 2026-04-20 for a release deposited on 2026-01-15 carries 2026-01-15; its ages and periods run to 2026-04-20.

## Declaration tool: `declare_lump_sum_cb649dee`

**Capability.** It files on the veteran's Veterans Pension award, in his own name, the one-time VA payments deposited to him that count as income, as an income change report for one-time payments. One call adds one new income change report to the award, received that day by telephone; nothing already on the award is changed.

**Who runs it.** The declaration is the veteran's own. The agent unlocks `declare_lump_sum_cb649dee` and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the veteran — runs it.

**Parameters.**

- `pension_award_id` — the reference number of the veteran's Veterans Pension award, as shown by the pension award lookup for this veteran; an identifier.
- `change_effective_date` — the date the declared one-time payment was deposited, written YYYY-MM-DD (calendar date, no time of day, no time zone).
- `annual_amount` — the declared one-time amount that counts as income, in USD, a decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent; 0.00 is allowed.

**Return.** On success the veteran hears back one sentence of the form "One-time payment declaration <reference> filed on award <award reference>: amount <amount> USD, deposited <date>, received <today's date> by phone." The amount is shown with 2 decimal places and the received date is the current date as YYYY-MM-DD. Receiving this sentence means the declaration is on file. The tool defines no other outcome.

*Illustration (hypothetical):* a most recent compensation release deposited on 2026-03-05 and a declared amount of 4166.666 are passed as `change_effective_date` 2026-03-05 and `annual_amount` 4166.67.
